en_title: Xbox Game Pass Reportedly Getting 'Major Overhaul,' Will Feature 'À La Carte' Options
subtitle: 功能按需选
opus_summary: 据《财富》报道，微软计划大改游戏订阅服务，让玩家按需选择功能。新方案将采用分级结构，主机专属游戏、云游戏和多人联机将作为附加选项，消息来自知情人士。

paragraphs.en: Microsoft is reportedly planning a substantial revamp of Xbox Game Pass that will allow subscribers to choose the features they want in an à la carte fashion. The report comes by way of a new Fortune profile piece on Xbox CEO Asha Sharma.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，微软正计划大幅调整XBOX Game Pass，让订阅用户像点菜一样，按需选择自己想要的功能。这一消息来自《财富》最新刊登的一篇关于XBOX首席执行官Asha Sharma的人物特写。

paragraphs.en: "Xbox is planning a major overhaul of Game Pass that would have players choose features à la carte," Fortune wrote, "including add-ons for console-only games, cloud gaming, and multiplayer, with the system operating on a tiered structure, according to people familiar with the strategy."
paragraphs.cn: Fortune写道：「据熟悉该策略的人士透露，XBOX正计划大幅调整Game Pass，让玩家按需选择功能。新方案将采用分级结构，附加选项包括主机专属游戏、云游戏和多人联机。」

paragraphs.en: The piece dug in on Xbox's controversial subscription gaming purchase, noting the challenges faced about the service internally: "Game Pass, a Netflix-style monthly gaming service, helped Xbox build a subscription business. But it also led to a cannibalization of sales for the company’s higher-priced first-party game titles, especially during the critical launch period. And competing internal metrics within different teams — such as subscription revenue versus store revenue — exacerbated the problem, said former employees."
paragraphs.cn: 这篇报道深入探讨了XBOX备受争议的游戏订阅服务，并指出这项服务在公司内部面临的挑战：「Game Pass是一项类似Netflix的游戏月费订阅服务，帮助XBOX建立了订阅业务。但它也分流了公司旗下定价较高的第一方游戏的销量，尤其是在至关重要的首发期。前员工表示，不同团队的内部考核指标相互冲突，例如订阅收入与商店收入之间的矛盾，进一步加剧了这个问题。」

paragraphs.en: Fortune's piece also addresses a next-gen Xbox handheld as well as the next-gen Project Helix console, suggesting that, as rumored, it won't be cheap — unless Microsoft chooses to subsidize any of the cost.
paragraphs.cn: 《财富》的报道还谈到了下一代XBOX掌机和下一代主机Project Helix，并暗示后者会如传闻所说，价格不菲——除非微软选择补贴部分成本。

paragraphs.en: A Game Pass revamp would be only the latest in a series of bold moves by Sharma, who has been on the job barely six months and has already cut the price of Game Pass Ultimate, signed Hideo Kojima's next-gen Metal Gear Solid spiritual successor project Physint , started two new verticals within Xbox, and handed development of Halo to Activision , to name a few. She's even found time to personally respond to customer support tickets and check out the latest build of The Elder Scrolls 6.
paragraphs.cn: 如果XBOX Game Pass迎来改版，那也只是Sharma一系列大胆举措中的最新一项。她上任才不过六个月，就已经下调了XBOX Game Pass Ultimate的价格，签下了小岛秀夫面向次世代的《潜龙谍影》精神续作项目《Physint》，在XBOX内部设立了两个新的业务部门，还将《光环》的开发工作交给了Activision——这些还只是其中一部分。她甚至抽出时间亲自回复客户支持工单，并体验了《上古卷轴6》的最新开发版本。

paragraphs.en: Ryan McCaffrey is IGN's executive editor of previews and host of IGN's weekly Xbox show, Podcast Unlocked , and a co-host of Next-Gen Console Watch . He's a North Jersey guy, so it's "Taylor ham," not "pork roll." Debate it with him on Twitter at @DMC_Ryan .
paragraphs.cn: Ryan McCaffrey是IGN预览内容执行主编，也是IGN每周XBOX节目《Podcast Unlocked》的主持人及《Next-Gen Console Watch》的联合主持人。他来自新泽西州北部，所以他把这种猪肉卷叫作「Taylor ham」，而不是「pork roll」。你可以在X上通过@DMC_Ryan与他辩论这个问题。
